text:
Priya: FYI — visiting researcher from Greenfield Labs (Dr. Kwan) arriving at 11:30 with a bulky crate for a short demo. She asked to drop it off first then grab a coffee. Can front desk accept and hold? 

FrontDeskBot: Delivery registered: 'Dr. Kwan / Greenfield Labs' 4kg crate, fragile, requires signature. Staging recommendation: reception cart or Meeting Zone B. Photo attached. :package::eyes:

Ethan: Im on desk coverage 11:00-13:00 today so I can handle intake. Is there a preferred staging spot that won't block the lobby?

Priya: Meeting Zone B (near the pantry) is ideal  less foot traffic. If cart doesn't fit, we can use the shorter table by the blue couch. Also heads-up: badge printer is out of black ribbon so lamination is flaky. Stickers are fine for now. :coffee:

Riley: There's a roll of visitor stickers in supply closet shelf 3. I put a note on the front desk binder with instructions for temporary badges (name, company, time in).

FrontDeskBot: Badge printer status: low ribbon. Alternative: single-use sticker badges available. Security policy reminder: visitors must be escorted beyond secure doors.

Camila: I'll meet Dr. Kwan in MR2 at 11:45 for the demo. If she needs anything moved, I have a hand truck and can help. 

Priya: Thanks  please also ask her to sign the liability form (paper in the front desk folder). If the crate is too large for MR2, we'll move to Conference A. 

Ethan: Noted. Gate code for loading area is in the 'site-ops' drawer (cleared for visitors). I'll sign and sticker the badge. Will someone claim the packaging after the demo? We have limited space in the parcel room.

OpsTeamBot: Temporary policy alert: 'Oversized demo materials' should be removed same-day unless authorized. Ops contact: @Camila. 

Camila: I can take responsibility for disposal if they don't want to keep packaging. I'll coordinate with Dr. Kwan after the demo. 

Priya: Great, thanks everyone. @Ethan please confirm when crate is accepted and when Dr. Kwan checks in. I'll update calendar invite to reflect staging instructions. :white_check_mark:

Ethan: Confirmed  crate accepted at 11:20, staged on short table by blue couch, sticker badge issued ("Dr. Kwan / Greenfield Labs / 11:20"). Dr. Kwan checked in at 11:28 and escorted to MR2.

FrontDeskBot: Check-in complete. Delivery status: staged -> MR2 pending. Badge log updated.

Priya: Awesome, thanks all. If anything else comes up I'll post here.
